title: A01 Transporter Authorisation (intra-EU)
description: Authorisation of the transporter by the competent authority of the Member State where it is established (Type 1: Art. 10; Type 2, long journeys: Art. 11).

x-traced.status: pre-project draft — subject to change in T4.1
x-traced.issuer: Competent authority of the Member State where the transporter is established (Art. 10(1)(a), Art. 12).
x-traced.holder: Transporter — the legal person's (EU Business) wallet.
verifiers: Competent authority of the place of departure (Art. 14(1)(a)(i))
Official veterinarians at control posts and exit points (Art. 21(1)(a))
Competent authority of the place of destination
legalBasis: Reg (EC) No 1/2005 Annex III, Chapters I and II (specimen authorisations)
x-traced.forwardCompatibility: COM(2023) 770 (proposal) — forward-compatibility only: transporter authorisation provisions; mapping in T2.1.
x-traced.validity: ≤ 5 years; changes to be notified within 15 working days (Art. 6(2)).
x-traced.revocation: Suspension or withdrawal (Art. 26(4)(c)) → status list update.
useCases: UC-3 official verification at control points
openQuestions: Reuse LPID/EUCC for the transporter identity once available in the EU Business Wallet; keep only the authorisation-specific claims here.

authorisationNumber.description: Number unique in the issuing Member State (Art. 13(2)).

authorisationType.description: type1 = Art. 10(1), not valid for long journeys; type2 = Art. 11(1), valid for all journeys incl. long journeys.

transporter.description: The authorised transporter (legal person). Name and number of Type 2 authorisations are public (Art. 13(4)).

scopeLimitations.description: Limitations set by the authority (Art. 13(1)), e.g. species or means of transport.

navigationSystemDemonstrated.description: Type 2 only: use of the navigation system demonstrated (Art. 11(2)).

issuingAuthority.description: Competent authority that granted the authorisation (one authority per transporter, Art. 12).

validUntil.description: End of validity; not more than five years from issue (Art. 10(2), 11(3)).
